GT.raw_binary_encoding: each image values subset of {0,1} OR {0,255}; nonzero maps exactly to1
GT.source: fixed original GT path/hash; hash before decode
GT.actual_class_counts_and_positive_pixels: unknown until explicit run decodes all1004
GT.normalized_cache: uint8 0/1, one decode per original GT; shared across all six models

AP.scope: global original pixels, each pixel once; no subsampling or mean per-image AP
AP.ties: all identical float32 values grouped; negative zero normalized to positive zero
AP.verification: original probe sklearn/ties evidence + frozen formula/native N/actual P checks
AP.no_positive_pixels: NA and stop; never positive evidence

image_metrics.AUROC: sklearn roc_auc_score on all1004 saved native maxima
image_metrics.threshold: original per-model Q summary path/hash; strict >, no recalibration
image_metrics.counts: TP/FN on actual anomaly denominator, FP/TN on actual normal denominator

pairs.mean: arithmetic mean of three paired deltas
pairs.judgement: all positive and mean>0: consistent preliminary; mixed mean>0: unstable; mean<=0: no average gain
pairs.limits: single category/fixed5/split; no significance/generalization/screen claim; disclose FP/FN tradeoffs

examples: first normal, first anomaly, smallest ID in union FP and union FN; deduplicate with all reasons

resource.checks: entry/GT image/AP input chunk/model boundary; frozen scan only has original entry gate, not continuous monitoring

cache: complete same identity only verifies; any partial/unknown/failure preserved, no resume/reaccumulate
prepare: metadata/hash/NPY headers/invented scalars only; no GT bytes/arrays or actual metrics
